summary:
ITER 181 — Frontend-only verification of Solution Finder 6-point UX polish + Pros & Cons Step 4/7/8 polish. ALL Solution Finder features PASS. Pros & Cons Step 7 features PASS. TWO issues found on Pros & Cons: (1) CRITICAL: Step 8 crashes at runtime with `ReferenceError: sectionPctByOptC1 is not defined` — the new Case-1 vs Case-2 comparison table cannot render at all; (2) MEDIUM: Step 4 sub-factor chips do not carry a `title="…"` attribute in the rendered DOM even though the JSX spreads `{...({ title: c.name } as any)}` — React-Native-Web strips the unknown prop from the underlying div/button, so the requested native browser hover-tooltip does NOT appear.

SOLUTION FINDER — all six items VERIFIED on mobile 390x844 as super@test.com on the sample entry 11cf0bc0-8086-40c3-a679-6da1ea10fdab (seeded with area+SMART+concern+RCA+sol+risk+mit+cont via PUT so every step is reachable):
  • Clickable breadcrumbs sf-breadcrumb-0..5 all render and are tappable forward once reachableMax permits. Jumping 0→3→4→5 works. reachableMax gating verified in-source (solution-finder.tsx:861-869).
  • AI credits meter row appears above the AI-fill button in Step 3 ("Est. ~14 credits · Balance 1274 · Top up", testID sf-meter-topup-sol ✓) and in Step 4 ("Est. ~18 credits · Balance 1274 · Top up", testID sf-meter-topup-risk ✓).
  • Step 4 hierarchy: solution card shows RCA trail chips "Backlog risk › Unclear priorities", Expand all / Collapse all bar renders (sf-risk-expand-all ✓, sf-risk-collapse-all ✓), tapping sf-risk-sol-toggle-s1 collapses the solution and shows a count pill.
  • Step 5 hierarchy + colors + collapse: after tapping "Build Action Plan" on Step 4 and "Re-aggregate" on Step 5, 3 action-plan items render with source-coloured left borders (Solution=indigo, Mitigation=green, Contingency=amber), a legend row (Solution/Mitigation/Contingency) shows, each card shows the lineage trail (Backlog risk › Unclear priorities › Weekly priority review › Team burnout), sf-ap-expand-all ✓, sf-ap-collapse-all ✓, sf-ap-toggle-{jgwjhng4|3da0w92k|0wh1rdlm} ✓ per item.
  • Report export: sf-download-pdf ✓ and sf-share-report ✓ render. Tapping Download PDF returns 402 and shows the custom "Unlock report" alert with "Not now" / "Open store" buttons (EXPECTED, per review spec). Tapping Share report opens the ReportShareSheet modal with WhatsApp / Email channel selector.

PROS & CONS Step 7 — VERIFIED on mobile 390x844 on a fresh analysis (98426703-317e-4083-bcfd-bbfa0444da69) seeded with 3 factors (1 mandatory + 2 optional) and 2 options via /api/pros-cons POST factors + PUT notation + POST options:
  • pc-toggle-gaps ✓ present next to Assess-all/Collapse-all. Default state = Show; "Gap above ↑ — adds +10" connector boxes visible between factor cards. Toggling to "Hide Realistic Gap" removes all connector boxes (verified: 'Gap above' absent from DOM). Per-factor pc-gap-toggle-{factorId} buttons appear on each factor once gaps are hidden (verified for both test factor ids).
  • Option names in expanded assess cards render with white-space:pre-wrap, textOverflow:clip, no line-clamp, no numberOfLines={1} — long option names wrap onto multiple lines (both TEST_Option Alpha and TEST_Option Beta shown fully).

ISSUES:

1) [P0] Pros & Cons Step 8 — Uncaught ReferenceError: sectionPctByOptC1 is not defined. Referenced at /app/frontend/app/tools/pros-cons-wizard.tsx:1950 (`const spC1 = sectionPctByOptC1[o.id] || …`) but only sectionPctByOpt is declared (line 1870). Effect: as soon as the user opens Step 8, React crashes and the entire step goes blank — the Case-1 vs Case-2 comparison table (Overall %, Score, Mandatory %, Optional %) never renders. The Change/delta arrow, Mandatory % and Optional % rows required by the review spec therefore cannot be verified live.
   Fix hint: compute sectionPctByOptC1 alongside sectionPctByOpt using case1ScoreByOpt-derived values for each mandatory/optional factor group (mirror lines 1870-1886 with the Case-1 baseline instead of the case-2 scores).

2) [P2/design] Pros & Cons Step 4 — Sub-factor chip `title` hover-tooltip missing from DOM. In /app/frontend/src/features/pros-cons/components.tsx:273 and :275 the TouchableOpacity and Text both use `{...({ title: c.name } as any)}` to try to add the native HTML `title` attribute for a web hover tooltip. On RN-Web this prop is stripped from the underlying <div> (`document.querySelectorAll('[title]').length === 0` after opening + Sub-factor). The chips themselves render correctly and are tappable, but the requirement "native web title attribute equal to the full factor name (hover tooltip)" is unmet.
   Fix hint: on web, render the chip through a Platform.OS==='web' branch that renders a real <div title={c.name}> wrapper, OR use react-native-web's `dataSet`/`accessibilityLabel` won't yield `title` — the cleanest fix is a Platform-gated raw <div>.

Step 8 currently CRASHES — do not treat the missing comparison table as a positive verification; the ReferenceError must be fixed first.
rca_of_issue: Step 8 crash: /app/frontend/app/tools/pros-cons-wizard.tsx builds `sectionPctByOpt` at lines 1870-1886 (Case-2 Mandatory% & Optional% per option) but never builds the corresponding Case-1 baseline map. However, line 1950 assumes the map exists: `const spC1 = sectionPctByOptC1[o.id] || { a: null, b: null };`. React re-throws the ReferenceError during render, so the whole Step-8 root gets replaced by React's error boundary (or blank body if none), taking down the Case-1/Case-2 comparison table, the Recompute button, the per-factor FactorAssessmentCard list, and the Show Final Decision Guidelines CTA. Reproduction: open any P&C analysis with ≥1 factor + ≥1 option and click the Step-8 tab (Assess). Mitigation: compute sectionPctByOptC1 alongside sectionPctByOpt using case1ScoreByOpt-derived per-section maxima (or, if the mandatory/optional split of the baseline is meant to equal case-2, pass sectionPctByOpt for both spC1 and sp). Step 4 title bug: RN-Web filters unknown DOM props on TouchableOpacity/Text; passing `title` via a spread doesn't survive React-DOM emission — needs a Platform.OS==='web' branch.
